episodes.211468: A coastal low rapidly deepened off the coast of Virginia from 1004mb along the Outer Banks on the morning of February 22 to 968mb off the Mid-Atlantic and New England coastline on the morning of February 23. This brought strong winds to the Atlantic coastal waters off the Eastern Shore late on February 22.
